domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Prepare operands for subtraction
skills.definition: Rewrite operands into a compatible form before subtraction, including normalizing whole numbers or mixed numbers and converting fractional parts to a common denominator when needed.
skills.merge_rationale: Inherited from the K=5 level. These are both setup operations that make later subtraction possible.

skills.name: Execute subtraction with regrouping when needed
skills.definition: Carry out subtraction of whole-number and fractional parts once quantities are compatible, including borrowing/regrouping from the whole-number part when the fractional subtraction cannot be completed directly.
skills.merge_rationale: S04 is a conditional extension of S03 during the execution phase: regrouping is invoked precisely when direct subtraction of aligned parts fails. In worked solutions, these two skills are tightly coupled and belong to the same arithmetic-execution phase, making this a meaningful coarser merge.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms or rewrite a zero-valued fraction as 0 after subtraction.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because simplification remains diagnostically useful and has a different error profile from both subtraction execution and final answer composition.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Present the computed result in its appropriate final form by combining whole and fractional parts or writing the result as a fraction, integer, or 0.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because answer composition is a presentation step that can fail independently of arithmetic and simplification.
